proposition.claim:
The standing base field in Sections 5–6 is algebraically closed, uncountable, and of characteristic zero (PDF p. 4 and the relevant section openings). A subgroup is not, by convention, required to be nontrivial: the paper explicitly adds that requirement in statements such as Theorem 6.1. Derived length means the least \(i\) for which the \(i\)-th derived subgroup is trivial, so the identity group has length zero.

For every connected commutative affine algebraic subgroup G of Bir(X), rRepl_X(G) is self-centralizing; G is not required to be nontrivial.
